# 04-validation: Comprehensive upgrade validation

Final validation pass: ensure the upgraded project is fully functional under .NET 8.

- Execute full test suite
- Validate runtime behavior against baseline
- Check for any latent compatibility issues
- Confirm deployment readiness

**Done when**:
- All tests pass
- Application runs without errors
- No unexpected behavior changes from .NET Framework 4.8 baseline
- Deployment/package build succeeds (if applicable)
